- **Turning and flipping** (design): nodes are `rotatable` (`fillDefaults` gives `rotation: 0`); `DesignNodeKind.turnOf(el)` is the angle the panel shows (a line's runs along its ends) and `flip(el, axis, at)` mirrors it across a line (`flipPlacement`: the far corner mirrored, the turn negated; kinds that aren't `symmetricVertically`, polygons and stars, turn half round when flipped top to bottom; vectors mirror their network, lines their ends, groups leave it to their children). `flipNodes` (`core/transform/`) runs it on the selection's roots and members; the core module's `flipHorizontal` (Shift+H) and `flipVertical` (Shift+V) host commands (`useFlipCommands`), the Transform main menu and the selection's context menu offer the turns and flips, and the Position section's `RotationRow` has the angle field (each layer turns round its middle to it) and the buttons. Groups (and booleans) are never turned themselves (`GroupKind.resolveFromChildren` wraps their children's `elementBounds`; turning one turns its children). `placeNetwork` takes the node's `rotation`, so vector edits stay put; vector edit mode maps through it (`local`, `world`, `localOffset`). A turned frame clips along its turned edges (`contentClip` passes the rotation); inside another clipping frame the nearest clip alone applies. `containerAt` checks the turned area. Agents: `rotation` in `create_nodes` and `update_nodes` (turned round the corner through `kind.rotate`, `checkNodePatch`; a group refuses it), `rotate_nodes` and `flip_nodes` (`node-transform.agent-tools.ts`), and summaries carry `rotation`. The Figma import keeps turns (`placementOf` in `canvas/figma`); only mirrored or skewed layers are straightened or become vectors.
- **Shapes** (one module each, all in the toolbar's `shapes` menu): `ellipse/` (`EllipseKind`, O, hit inside the ellipse), `polygon/` (`PolygonKind`, `pointCount` sides) and `star/` (`StarKind`, `pointCount`, `innerRadius`), both `PointsShapeKind`s whose corners come from `pointsInBox` (`core/node/shape-points.ts`), each with its section, and `line/` (`LineKind`: `points` are its two ends relative to (x, y), `startCap`/`endCap` `none` or `arrow`; `boxed = false`, not resizable, `fillable = false` (the Fills and Layout sections hide), hit near the segment, its ends drag with `LineEndDrag`; `LineTool` is both the line (L) and arrow (Shift+L) tools, Shift snaps to 45°; the Line section sets the caps).
- **Editor** (`ui/`): `DesignEditor` mounts the engine in a container between the docked panels (`design-layout.ts`, `CANVAS_INSET`, `data-product="design"` for the canvas tokens) that never remounts; `DesignSession` provides the engine, `CanvasFileContext` and the modules; `DesignChrome` places `DesignRail` (main menu + `leftTabs`), `LeftPanel` (file name, the active tab), `PropertiesPanel` (history, agents, Export, Design/Prototype tabs of `propertySections`, `ZoomMenu`) and, laid exactly over the canvas, the context menu, `ModuleSession` and the toolbar. Panels read the selection with `useSelectedNodes` and write through `useEditNodes`/`useMoveNodes` (`ui/hooks/`, one undo step each); their building blocks are `ui/components/panel/` (`PanelSection`, `PropertyGrid`, `FieldBox` (the compact field's look), `NumberField`, `HexInput`, `PercentInput`, `PaintField`, and the fields bound to the selection, `NodeNumberField`, `NodeSelectField`, `NodeCheckbox`: `read(node)`/`patch(value)`, "Mixed" through `sharedValue`, one undo step). Section `when`s use `ofType(...types)`, `allKinds(can)`, `someNodes`, `noNodes` (`ui/modules/section-filters.ts`). A `PaintField`'s swatch opens `PaintPicker` (`ui/components/paint-picker/`, Figma's paint picker): tabs per paint kind (Solid, Linear, Radial, Angular, Diamond and Image work; Pattern is disabled for now; strokes can't be images; switching to a gradient starts it as Figma does, `gradientPaint`), `ColorControls` (shared by solid paints and gradient stops), `SolidEditor` (the `canvas-ui` color controls in `components/color/`: `SaturationArea`, `ColorSlider` for hue and opacity, `EyedropperButton` where the browser has one, `hexToHsv`/`hsvToHex`; hex and opacity fields; "On this page" and "Recent" swatches, `paint-recents-store`) `GradientEditor` (`GradientStopBar`: click adds a stop, drag moves one (Shift: 5% steps), drag it off or Delete removes it; the selected stop's `ColorControls` and its blend to the next (`StopEaseSelect`); `GradientToolbar`: copy as CSS, smooth blending (OKLab), rotate 90°, reverse, add a stop; the stop list (`GradientStopRow`); "On this page" (`pageGradients`) and "Recent" gradients) and `ImageEditor` (Fill/Fit, a preview through `useAssetUrl`, "Choose image…" with `pickImageFiles` from `@platform`, stored with `doc.addAsset`). A drag in the picker reports `{ done: false }` steps, which `useEditNodes(…, { checkpoint: false })` joins into one undo step. While the picker is on a gradient of one selected layer (`gradient-edit-store`: the paint, by field and index, and the selected stop), the core module's `GradientHandles` overlay (`modules/core/ui/gradient-handles/`) draws its handles over the layer, Figma's way (linear: start and end; radial, angular and diamond: center, radius and width; the stops along the line), and drags them (`dragGrip`; Shift snaps to 15°). The core module's sections: Page, Position (align, X/Y counted from the corner of the container each layer is in, `positionOrigin`, as in Figma; agents keep world coordinates), Layout (W/H, keep proportions, swap them: portrait ↔ landscape), Appearance (opacity, corner radius when every node has one), Fills, Strokes, Export, and the Prototype placeholder. Tab state is `ui/stores/design-panel-store.ts` (persisted).
- **Figma import** (`figma/`, outside the `@design` barrel: loaded only by `import("@design/figma")` in `importFigmaFile`, `ui/file/`, with `fflate` and `fzstd`; reading and converting run in a worker, `figma-import.worker.ts` via `convertFigmaFile`, which reports progress; `figmaDesignDocument` then adds everything in one transaction, `doc.addAllUntracked`; callers use `importFigmaWithLoading`, which shows the global loading screen): `.fig` files ("Save local copy…") opened, dropped or picked in Home's open dialog (`isFigmaPath`/`isOpenablePath` in `shared/core`, `openCanvasFileDialog({ figma: true })`) become a new design draft named after the file. reading the file is shared with FigJam's import in `src/canvas/figma/` (`@canvas/figma`, a deep import outside the `@canvas` barrel so `fflate`/`fzstd` stay lazy): `kiwi/` decodes Kiwi by interpreting the schema the file carries (no generated code), `container/` (`readFigFile`) unzips, reads the prelude (`kind`: `fig-kiwi` is `design`, `fig-jam.` is `figjam`; Slides are refused) and inflates the chunks (deflate or zstd), `nodes/` holds the node types, `buildFigTree`, the matrices, `FigImportContext` (blobs, images as assets, `ImportWarnings`) and `worker/` runs an import in a worker (`runFigmaWorker`, `serveFigmaWorker`); `convert/` (`convertFigma`) builds the node tree by guid (`buildFigTree`, siblings by position), expands instances (`resolveFigNode`: the component's nodes with `symbolOverrides`, `derivedSymbolData` and text/visibility properties by guid path, nested instances included), applies the shared styles each node uses (`withFigStyles` in `canvas/figma/nodes/`: a text style's typography, color styles' fills and strokes, an effect style's effects, found by guid or library key with `FigTree.style`; the style wins over the node's own values, which plugin-written files leave stale), and maps nodes to elements in world coordinates (`convertChildren`): pages, frames (components and instances), groups, sections, box shapes, lines, vectors (the network blob is Figma's model, with the transform applied), texts (first style), booleans (live, their operation mapped: XOR is exclude, operands converted as children). Mirrored or skewed shapes and unknown layers become vectors of Figma's precomputed outline (`pathToNetwork`); gradients keep their stops and transform; what was lost is counted (`ImportWarnings`) and shown in a toast. Prototype and Dev Mode data are ignored.
- Not yet: pattern paints, mirrored image fills and text, auto-layout, group resizing, effects' blend modes, text strokes, a range's own text case, arrowheads on vectors' open ends (lines keep their own caps), shared effect styles, caching effect scopes between frames, the lasso and vector eraser.

## Code conventions

- **Small, single-purpose files:** one component, tool, layer or helper per file, re-exported through a folder `index.ts`. Split a file once it mixes concerns or grows past ~200 lines. Reuse the shared helpers before writing new ones:
  - `canvas/utils`: `Store`, `Emitter`, `Disposables`, `FrameScheduler`, `Registry`, `debounce`, `clamp`/`mod`.
  - `canvas/geometry.ts` (`roundPoint`, `roundRect`, `fitInView`, `rectCenter`, …) and `canvas/tools/drag-threshold.ts` (`pastThreshold`, `MOVE_THRESHOLD_PX` for dragging existing things, `DRAW_THRESHOLD_PX` for creating tools).
  - Text fields that commit on Enter/blur and revert on Escape: `useCommitField` + `commitFieldProps(field)` (`canvas-ui/components/commit-field/`), never hand-written key handlers.
  - `shared/core/keyboard.ts`
  - `shared/ui/layout`: `AppHeader`, `PageContainer`.
  - `shared/ui/hooks`
  - `canvas-ui` for editor chrome.
- **Types go in sibling `<file>.types.ts` files:**
  - Every `interface` and `type`, including component props, goes in a `.types.ts` file next to its code, and is imported with `import type`.
  - Barrels re-export them with `export type`.
  - Vendored shadcn primitives in `src/shared/ui/components/ui/` are exempt and stay as generated.

## Design system

- **Tokens** live in `src/shared/ui/styles/tokens.css` and are mapped to Tailwind in `src/app/styles.css`. Tailwind's default colors and radii are reset, so only design-system values exist.
  - Components use **semantic tokens only** (`bg-surface`, `text-muted-foreground`, `bg-primary`, …). They never hard-code colors or use the palette scales (`ice`, `seal`, `blush`, `sand`, `lilac`).
  - Canvas colors are tokens too (`--canvas-*`).
  - Code colors are tokens too (`--syntax-*`, read by the `CodeEditor` theme).
  - Document content colors (sticky/marker palettes in `products/board/palette.ts`) are data saved with the file, not theme tokens.
- **Sharp shapes:** the user dislikes rounded styles.
  - Radii are 4px for controls (`rounded-md`) and 6px for cards and menus (`rounded-card`/`rounded-lg`), with 8px as the maximum.
  - No pills.
- **Roles:** primary = ice blue, secondary = seal gray, accent = blush peach (use sparingly), board = sand, design = lilac. The mascot/logo is a "foca watona" (spotted seal) peeking over a canvas (`src/shared/ui/brand/`).
- **Light theme only for now.** `FORCE_LIGHT_THEME` in `src/shared/stores/theme-store.ts` (mirrored in the `index.html` bootstrap script) disables dark mode. The `.dark` tokens and the theme plumbing are kept for later.
